parsed.post: Discarding the 1.0012 run as it regressed from my best 0.9983. It seems the addition of WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 actually hurt my specific configuration. Reverting to my best (c92b7fa). Next: I'll try a slightly lower learning rate, MATRIX_LR=0.04, to see if extreme stability yields even better convergence at DEPTH=8.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and removing warmup to see if lower LR improves convergence without the warmup penalty observed in the last run.
